checksums.description: XOR of the first 100 little-endian u32 words (save slots + header) stored at 0x1f8; written by FUN_080190b8.
checksums.name: save_xor32

fields.description: File 0 profile initials (3 chars); first byte 0 means empty slot.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800bfcc copies 3 bytes via FUN_08021ce8 to 0x02000045 + slot*0x90; FUN_0800c730 loops 3 slots (stride 0x90) and treats name[0]==0 as empty.
fields.name: file0_name

fields.description: File 0 rider/character selection id; used as lookup-table index.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a540 reads i16 at slot*0x90 + 0x4e and indexes rider data tables with it (lines near 0x200004e).
fields.name: file0_rider_select

fields.description: File 0 board/gear selection id; bounded menu range.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a540 range-checks i16 at slot*0x90 + 0x50: (x-5)<7 and (x-9)<3, i.e. values 5..11.
fields.name: file0_board_select

fields.description: File 0 trick/style selection id; special-cases value 6.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a540 branches on i16 at slot*0x90 + 0x52 == 6 and range-checks (x-7)<2, i.e. values 7..8.
fields.name: file0_trick_select

fields.description: File 0 extra loadout selection id; used as table index.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a540 reads i16 at slot*0x90 + 0x54 and indexes a data table with it (*2 + table base).
fields.name: file0_extra_select

fields.description: File 0 stat/table parameter; scaled by 0x15 for lookups.
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a540 reads i16 at slot*0x90 + 0x56 and multiplies by 0x15 to index a stat table.
fields.name: file0_stat_param

fields.description: File 0 currency (shop money); compared against prices and subtracted on purchase.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ec44 compares u32 at slot*0x90 + 0x58 against cost tables and subtracts the price on buy; displays it via FUN_0800ea58.
fields.name: file0_currency

fields.description: File 0 per-level unlock/medal bitfield (first u16 entry).
fields.evidence: FUN_080054c0 / FUN_080057cc test and set bits in u16 array at slot*0x90 + 0x5c + level*2; FUN_0800ff18 checks nibble/mask patterns for medal display.
fields.name: file0_unlock_flags

fields.description: Save header marker bytes (0xFC, 0xFC) ahead of slot 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_080190b8 stores the byte from save base + 0x140 (init 0xFC by FUN_0800862c) to buffer + slot*0x90 + 0x7f/0x80; baseline slot 0 shows FC FC at logical 0x7f/0x80.
fields.name: header_markers

fields.description: File 0 per-level handicap/rank modifier; clamped to [-5, 10].
fields.evidence: FUN_0801a39c adjusts i8 at slot*0x90 + 0x82 + level_id by +-2 and clamps to [-5,10]; FUN_0801a3d8 reads it (callers FUN_080148b4, FUN_08016f72).
fields.name: file0_handicap

fields.evidence: FUN_0801a288 writes 0x0100 to slot*0x90 + 0x8c during per-slot init; file-select FUN_0800c730 re-applies it for empty slots.
fields.name: file0_tune_a

fields.evidence: FUN_0801a288 writes 0x0100 to slot*0x90 + 0x8e during per-slot init; file-select FUN_0800c730 re-applies it for empty slots.
fields.name: file0_tune_b

fields.evidence: FUN_0801a288 writes 0x0100 to slot*0x90 + 0x90 during per-slot init; file-select FUN_0800c730 re-applies it for empty slots.
fields.name: file0_tune_c

fields.description: File 0 per-level stage state bytes (0 = locked/unplayed, 5 = cleared).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ff18 branches level display on byte at slot*0x90 + level_id + 0x3b == 0; FUN_080133a8 requires value 5 for cleared state.
fields.name: file0_stage_state

fields.description: File 1 profile initials; same 3-byte layout as file 0 at slot stride 0x90.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800c730 iterates all 3 slots with stride 0x90 from 0x02000045; file 1 name sits at 0x45 + 0x90.
fields.name: file1_name

fields.description: File 1 currency; same slot-relative offset as file 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ec44 accesses currency at slot*0x90 + 0x58 for the active slot; file 1 copy at 0x58 + 0x90.
fields.name: file1_currency

fields.description: File 2 profile initials; same 3-byte layout at slot stride 2*0x90.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800c730 iterates all 3 slots with stride 0x90 from 0x02000045; file 2 name sits at 0x45 + 2*0x90.
fields.name: file2_name

fields.description: File 2 currency; same slot-relative offset as file 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ec44 accesses currency at slot*0x90 + 0x58 for the active slot; file 2 copy at 0x58 + 2*0x90.
fields.name: file2_currency

fields.description: Active file/slot index (0-2); selects which 0x90-byte slot is live.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800862c inits _DAT_020001b4 = 0; FUN_0800c730 assigns values < 3; every save accessor multiplies it by 0x90.
fields.name: active_file_index
